login.fallbackText: Try again. If this continues, tell whoever runs the server.

action.login: Sign in with email and password

fallback.title: Sign in failed
fallback.text: Try again. If this continues, tell whoever runs the server.

provider_denied.title: Sign in cancelled
provider_denied.text: The provider did not grant access. Try again, or use email and password.

invalid_request.title: Incomplete response from the provider
invalid_request.text: The response is missing data. Try again from the provider button.

invalid_state.title: Invalid sign in request
invalid_state.text: The request expired or started in another browser. Try again from this browser.

exchange_failed.title: The provider did not complete sign in
exchange_failed.text: Try again shortly. If this continues, use email and password or tell an administrator.

email_unverified.title: Email not verified
email_unverified.text: The provider does not confirm your email. Verify it in your provider account, then try again.

email_in_use.title: This email already has an account
email_in_use.text: The account has a password and the email is not verified, so the provider cannot link to it. Sign in with email and password.

identity_conflict.title: Provider linked to another profile
identity_conflict.text: Your account already uses another profile from this provider. Sign in with that profile, or with email and password.

registration_closed.title: Registration is closed
registration_closed.text: No account uses this email and new users are not accepted. Ask an administrator to create your account.

setup_required.title: The first administrator is missing
setup_required.text: You create the first account with the setup code, not with a provider.

account_disabled.title: Account disabled
account_disabled.text: Ask an administrator to reactivate it.

server_error.title: Server error
server_error.text: Sign in failed. Try again shortly. If this continues, tell whoever runs the server.

live.noFilters: Live view does not support key=value filters. Remove them to go live.
live.waitingText: New events that match these filters appear here as they arrive.

first.title: Send the first event to {{project}}
first.text: Connect a server in three steps. It takes about a minute.
first.step1Text: Your server sends events with this token. It can only write logs to this project.
first.step2Text: Run this from your server, or send a test event from here.
first.tokenOnce: Copy the token now. You will not see it again after you leave this page.
first.testMessage: Test event from the setup page
first.forbidden: You need permission to manage tokens. Ask a project admin.
first.tokenFailed: Could not create the token. Try again.
first.sendFailed: The test event was not accepted. Try again or use the command above.

tokens.intro: Servers and scripts use API tokens to send or read logs. Each token belongs to this project.
tokens.createdText: Copy it now. You will not see it again.
tokens.forbidden: You need permission to manage tokens. Ask a project admin.
tokens.revokeConfirm: Revoke {{name}}? Anything using it stops working.
tokens.name: Name

users.intro: These people can open {{workspace}} and every project in it. A role sets what each person can do.
users.forbidden: You need permission to manage members. Ask a workspace owner or admin.
users.lastOwner: A workspace needs at least one owner. Make someone else owner first.
users.emailHint: The person needs an account on this instance already.
users.noAccount: No account uses this email. Ask an instance admin to create it first.
users.already: This person is already a member.

roleText.owner: Everything, including workspace settings and granting the owner role.
roleText.admin: Manage members, tokens, storage and alerts. Read, export and delete logs.
roleText.developer: Create projects and tokens, set up alerts, read and export logs.
